description: Actions anchored to the control that opens them (DESIGN.md, Menu). Opens under anchor aligned to its end edge, above when there is no room; the first item is focused (fromEnd: the last), arrows wrap, Home, End and type-ahead move, Enter and Space choose; Escape, Tab and an outside press close it, and focus returns to anchor. barrierLabel names an invisible full-screen control behind the panel that closes it, for a screen reader; without one, it carries no label.

statics.name: show
statics.signature: Future<void> show(BuildContext anchor, {required List<MenuItem> items, String? barrierLabel, bool fromEnd = false})
statics.description: Shows a menu of items anchored to anchor's own render box.
